text: Added a new Handoff Rules convention to agents.md (d289f1f21): remove a slice's scratch build/verification directory once its PR merges or closes, rather than leaving it. Motivated by a real incident today -- 139 accumulated per-slice /tmp scratch directories from completed PRs (~21GB) exhausted the host's tmpfs quota and intermittently broke shell tool execution for both of us. The user asked me to clean it up (done, with their explicit sign-off given the scale) and add the convention so it doesn't recur. No runtime/test/release behavior changed. No synchronous acknowledgment needed.
